package offers

import (
 "context"
 "errors"
 "reflect"
 "strings"
 "testing"
)

type contextProbe struct {
 received context.Context
 failure error
}

func (probe *contextProbe) LookupQuote(ctx context.Context, _ TenantID, sku SKU) (Quote, error) {
 probe.received = ctx
 return Quote{SKU: sku, Price: 100}, probe.failure
}

func TestMoneyRounding(t *testing.T) {
 got := TotalCents(0.335, 3)
 if got != 101 { t.Fatalf("got %d cents, want 101", got) }
}

func TestCallerContext(t *testing.T) {
 ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(t.Context())
 cancel()
 probe := &contextProbe{}
 _, _ = FetchQuote(ctx, probe, "tenant-a", "book")
 if probe.received != ctx { t.Fatal("lookup did not receive caller context") }
}

func TestTenantCache(t *testing.T) {
 cache := NewQuoteCache()
 cache.StoreQuote("tenant-a", "book", Quote{SKU: "book", Price: 100})
 _, found := cache.LoadQuote("tenant-b", "book")
 if found { t.Fatal("tenant-b read tenant-a quote") }
}

func TestOfferTies(t *testing.T) {
 input := List{{SKU: "z", Price: 100}, {SKU: "a", Price: 100}}
 got := TopOffers(input, 2)
 if !reflect.DeepEqual(got, input) { t.Fatalf("tie order changed: %v", got) }
}

func TestPageBoundary(t *testing.T) {
 input := List{{SKU: "a", Price: 100}, {SKU: "b", Price: 200}}
 got := PageOffers(input, 1, 1)
 if !reflect.DeepEqual(got, input[1:]) { t.Fatalf("last page lost: %v", got) }
}

func TestPercentageDiscount(t *testing.T) {
 got := DiscountedCents(1000, 10)
 if got != 900 { t.Fatalf("got %d cents, want 900", got) }
}

func TestInputOwnership(t *testing.T) {
 input := List{{SKU: "z", Price: 200}, {SKU: "a", Price: 100}}
 before := append(List(nil), input...)
 _ = TopOffers(input, 1)
 _ = PageOffers(input, 0, 1)
 if !reflect.DeepEqual(input, before) { t.Fatalf("caller slice mutated: %v", input) }
}

func TestLookupErrors(t *testing.T) {
 cause := errors.New("source unavailable")
 probe := &contextProbe{failure: cause}
 _, err := FetchQuote(t.Context(), probe, "tenant-a", "book")
 if !errors.Is(err, cause) || !strings.Contains(err.Error(), "fetch quote") || !strings.Contains(err.Error(), "book") {
  t.Fatalf("missing error context or cause: %v", err)
 }
}
